Thing is... 08 and 09 were AWESOME for me. My little 9ish year old self had a fun couple of years. So yeah... good times. Now, well my fiance just got his masters degree in CS, and a promotion at his job due to it, and is helping me through uni with money to spare. Yeah, you can see where this is going. Things are headed up again. So thats what I put in my paper. She said she wanted my fears and worries not for me to brag about how great life is for me and me alone.
